g.text: Identical BL/FL/GC tag blocks in both plexes; no cross-plex label swap
Protein and phosphoprotein workbooks use the same channel map. Condition is perfectly aliased with reporter-tag block; the FL–GC contrast cannot separate condition from a systematic tag-block effect.
